title: Grid the Gallery
prompt:
Build a photo gallery board:

- `.gallery` is a grid with **three equal columns** and a `1rem` gap between all cells.
- The `.featured` tile spans the full width of the first row.
- The remaining tiles flow into the grid automatically (no per-tile placement needed).

tests.name: gallery is a 3-column grid with gap
featured tile spans full width
tests.hint: grid-column: 1 / -1 stretches from the first to the last column line.
